machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;===== machine: P1S (estampo/CuraEngine) =====
;===== turn on the HB fan & MC board fan =====
M104 S75 ;set extruder temp to turn on HB fan
M710 A1 S255 ;turn on MC board fan (P1S)
;===== reset machine status =====
M290 X40 Y40 Z2.6666666
G91
M17 Z0.4 ; lower z-motor current
G380 S2 Z30 F300 ; lower hotbed
G380 S2 Z-25 F300
G1 Z5 F300
G90
M17 X1.2 Y1.2 Z0.75 ; reset motor current
M960 S5 P1 ; turn on logo lamp
G90
M220 S100 ;Reset Feedrate
M221 S100 ;Reset Flowrate
M73.2 R1.0 ;Reset left time magnitude
M1002 set_gcode_claim_speed_level : 5
M221 X0 Y0 Z0 ; turn off soft endstop
G29.1 Z0 ; clear z-trim value
M204 S10000 ; init ACC 10m/s^2

;===== heatbed preheat =====
M1002 gcode_claim_action : 2
M140 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} ;set bed temp
M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} ;wait for bed temp

M106 P2 S100 ; turn on big fan to cool toolhead

;===== prepare print temperature =====
M104 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} ;set extruder temp
G91
G0 Z10 F1200
G90
G28 X
M975 S1 ; turn on vibration suppression
G1 X60 F12000
G1 Y245
G1 Y265 F3000
M620 M ;AMS
M620 S0A ; switch material if AMS exists
    M109 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0}
    G1 X120 F12000
    G1 X20 Y50 F12000
    G1 Y-3
    T0
    G1 X54 F12000
    G1 Y265
    M400
M621 S0A

M412 S1 ; turn on filament runout detection

M109 S250 ;set nozzle to common flush temp
M106 P1 S0
G92 E0
G1 E50 F200
M400
M104 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0}
G92 E0
G1 E50 F200
M400
M106 P1 S255
G92 E0
G1 E5 F300
M109 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0 - 20} ; drop temp for filament shrink

G1 E-0.5 F300
G1 X70 F9000
G1 X76 F15000
G1 X65 F15000
G1 X76 F15000
G1 X65 F15000 ; shake to put down garbage
G1 X80 F6000
G1 X95 F15000
G1 X80 F15000
G1 X165 F15000 ; wipe and shake
M400
M106 P1 S0
;===== prepare print temperature end =====

;===== wipe nozzle =====
M1002 gcode_claim_action : 14
M975 S1
M106 S255
G1 X65 Y230 F18000
G1 Y264 F6000
M109 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0 - 20}
G1 X100 F18000 ; first wipe

G0 X135 Y253 F20000 ; move to exposed steel surface
G28 Z P0 T300 ; home Z with low precision
G29.2 S0 ; turn off ABL
G0 Z5 F20000

G1 X60 Y265
G92 E0
G1 E-0.5 F300 ; retract
G1 X100 F5000 ; second wipe
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X100 F5000
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X100 F5000
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X100 F5000
G1 X70 F15000
G1 X90 F5000
G0 X128 Y261 Z-1.5 F20000 ; nozzle on exposed steel
M104 S140 ; set temp down to heatbed-safe
M106 S255 ; fan on

M221 S ; push soft endstop status
M221 Z0 ; turn off Z endstop
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y259.5 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y262.5
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y260.0
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y262.0
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y260.5
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y261.5
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 Z0.5 F20000
G0 X125 Y261.0
G0 Z-1.01
G0 X131 F211
G0 X124
G0 X128
G2 I0.5 J0 F300
G2 I0.5 J0 F300
G2 I0.5 J0 F300
G2 I0.5 J0 F300

M109 S140 ; wait nozzle temp down
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000
G2 I0.5 J0 F3000

M221 R ; pop soft endstop status
G1 Z10 F1200
M400
G1 Z10
G1 F30000
G1 X230 Y15
G29.2 S1 ; turn on ABL
M106 S0 ; turn off fan
;===== wipe nozzle end =====

;===== bed leveling =====
M1002 judge_flag g29_before_print_flag
M622 J1
    M1002 gcode_claim_action : 1
    G29 A X0 Y0 I256 J256
    M400
    M500 ; save cali data
M623
;===== bed leveling end =====

;===== home after wipe =====
M1002 judge_flag g29_before_print_flag
M622 J0
    M1002 gcode_claim_action : 13
    G28
M623
;===== home after wipe end =====

M975 S1 ; vibration suppression

M106 P2 S100 ; big fan to cool toolhead

M104 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} ; set extrude temp

;===== mech mode fast check =====
G1 X128 Y128 Z10 F20000
M400 P200
M970.3 Q1 A7 B30 C80 H15 K0
M974 Q1 S2 P0

G1 X128 Y128 Z10 F20000
M400 P200
M970.3 Q0 A7 B30 C90 Q0 H15 K0
M974 Q0 S2 P0

M975 S1
G1 F30000
G1 X230 Y15
G28 X ; re-home XY
;===== mech mode fast check end =====

;===== nozzle load line =====
M975 S1
G90
M83
T1000
G1 X18.0 Y1.0 Z0.8 F18000 ;Move to start
M109 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0}
G1 Z0.2
G0 E2 F300
G0 X240 E15 F3600
G0 Y11 E0.700 F900
G0 X239.5
G0 E0.2
G0 Y1.5 E0.700
G0 X25 E15 F3600
M400

;===== for Textured PEI Plate =====
{if machine_buildplate_type=='textured_pei_plate'}
G29.1 Z-0.04
{endif}
;===== turn off lights, wait for temp =====
M1002 gcode_claim_action : 0
M106 S0 ; turn off fan
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off big fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber fan

M975 S1 ; mech mode suppression

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;===== P1S end gcode =====
M400 ; wait for buffer to clear
G92 E0 ; zero the extruder
G1 E-0.8 F1800 ; retract
G1 Z{machine_height + 0.5} F900 ; lower z a little
G1 X65 Y245 F12000 ; move to safe pos
G1 Y265 F3000

G1 X65 Y245 F12000
G1 Y265 F3000
M140 S0 ; turn off bed
M106 S0 ; turn off fan
M106 P2 S0 ; turn off remote part cooling fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber cooling fan

G1 X100 F12000 ; wipe
; pull back filament to AMS
M620 S255
G1 X20 Y50 F12000
G1 Y-3
T255
G1 X65 F12000
G1 Y265
G1 X100 F12000 ; wipe
M621 S255
M104 S0 ; turn off hotend

M622.1 S1 ; for prev firmware, default turned on
M1002 judge_flag timelapse_record_flag
M622 J1
    M400 ; wait all motion done
    M991 S0 P-1 ;end smooth timelapse at safe pos
    M400 S3 ;wait for last picture to be taken
M623 ; end of timelapse_record_flag

M400 ; wait all motion done
M17 S
M17 Z0.4 ; lower z motor current
G1 Z250 F600
G1 Z248
M400 P100
M17 R ; restore z current

M220 S100 ; Reset feedrate magnitude
M201.2 K1.0 ; Reset acc magnitude
M73.2 R1.0 ;Reset left time magnitude
M1002 set_gcode_claim_speed_level : 0

M17 X0.8 Y0.8 Z0.5 ; lower motor current to 45% power
M960 S5 P0 ; turn off logo lamp
